reviews.title: Painful experience. STAY AWAY FROM THIS APP
reviews.text:
Poorly written app. Has no Settings, No help. Just a scam to for e you to see ad after ad. It has no more than 10 noise offerings, only the first one is free. Do you want to open other noises? You must watch 3 or 4 ads. Sometimes the ads show nothing. You leave the app sitting there showing nothing. You have to restart is. And the 5 or 10 minutes you wasted running an “empty” add? Sucker: it doesn’t count. You have to *try* again, try watching a blank ad that never ends. 
So… you CANNOT add any more noise choices. 
You are able to run the noise for 5 minutes. You want to let it run for 15 minutes? You got to watch more ads. You want it to run for 20 minutes? You’re SOL, because that’s not an option. Only 15 minutes, 30, 1 hour and 2 hours are options. AFTER you watched ads. If those ads work properly (they won’t).

STAY AWAY FROM THIS APP!!!

reviews.title: Are the sounds a loop made with AI
reviews.text: The sounds have far too much consistency. There’s no randomness or variation in the sounds from moment to moment. At least not enough to make it feel real. It feels unnatural and in doing so, doesn’t achieve the background noise effect it is going for. It’s too consistent. Even the white noise is too consistently “white noise” that it doesn’t achieve what true white noise does.
